scope: Build record for the Bridge source package handed to the web_agent project. Records what was packaged and what was deliberately left out; claims nothing about whether the code runs in that project.
archiveSha256Note: Reproducible: zip entries are pinned to a fixed timestamp, so rebuilding identical content yields this same digest.
